entries.mitigation: Stay out of the tornado paths and keep Ra Kotu faced away from the group.
Main tank blocks and keeps the frontal cleave pointed away from the raid.

entries.entry_name: Split — Yokeda Kai and Yokeda Rok'dun
entries.mitigation: Assign one player to each Kai copy, identify the real boss, and interrupt every flame channel immediately.

entries.entry_name: Welwa Adds — Yokeda Kai and Yokeda Rok'dun
entries.mitigation: Keep the welwas controlled on the tank; kill enraged or excess welwas before they overwhelm the tank.

entries.entry_name: Side Wipe Enrage — Yokeda Kai and Yokeda Rok'dun
entries.mitigation: Both split groups must stay alive. A wipe on one side can enrage the boss on the surviving side.
Spread enough to read the projectiles, dodge their paths, and keep the boss controlled in one direction.
In Hard Mode, free Stone Formed players immediately with Destructive Outbreak.
